title: Katana girl standing portrait rig v2 (社外秘)
source_art: /workspace/art/edits/katana_fix/katana_fixed_cutout.png（絵の破綻修正版）。顔は一切加工していない

coordinates.canvas: source px 1200x1600, origin top-left, y DOWN, angle + = clockwise on screen
coordinates.rig_local: Unity: x = px/PPU, y = -py/PPU (origin canvas top-left, y up). Unity angle = -canvas angle, Unity dy = -canvas dy
coordinates.mesh: vertices_canvas_px = rest position on the canvas. vertices_sprite_px = origin sprite-rect bottom-left, y up. uv = 0..1 in the sprite texture

render_order: sorting_order ascending = back to front: fill_behind_ponytail < ponytail < blade_back < head < body < cord_L < cord_R < FX

deform_model.summary: Every vertex has a fixed rest position p (canvas px) and per-vertex coefficients (vertex_fields). Each frame: posed = p + d(p). Formulas below are exactly the reference renderer (anim_v2.py).
deform_model.U: Body transform: rotate by theta about PIV, then translate (tx, ty). U(p) = R(theta)*(p-PIV) + PIV + (tx,ty)
deform_model.U_head: same theta/tx, ty_head = ty + (1-HEAD_K)*(BREATH*breath + 1.6*lift)  (head rises 80% of the shoulders)
deform_model.ponytail: d = wU*(U(p)-p) + g * S_pony(t - tau_s)   (S_pony = spring output, sampled with the per-vertex delay)
deform_model.head: d = U_head(p)-p + w_side * S_side(t)   (face area has w_side = 0 -> face is rigid)
deform_model.wU: 1 - smoothstep((y-700)/350)  (1 above y=700: head/arms/katana; 0 at y>=1050: hips/legs never move)
deform_model.rigid_guarantee: katana (blade, tsuba, hilt) and the gripping hand: wU=1 and expand=0 -> pure U (affine residual < 0.001 px). face: pure U_head

pony.law: a = 2nd derivative of the anchor position (px/s^2, canvas); F = -inertia_gain*4.0*a + wn^2*idle(t); v += dt*(F - 2*damping*wn*v - wn^2*x); x += dt*v (240Hz). output = 6*tanh(x/6) px

side.law: a = 2nd derivative of the anchor position (px/s^2, canvas); F = -inertia_gain*4.0*a + wn^2*idle(t); v += dt*(F - 2*damping*wn*v - wn^2*x); x += dt*v (240Hz). output = 6*tanh(x/6) px

cordL.law: a = 2nd derivative of the anchor position (px/s^2, canvas); F = -inertia_gain*4.0*a + wn^2*idle(t); v += dt*(F - 2*damping*wn*v - wn^2*x); x += dt*v (240Hz). output = 6*tanh(x/6) px

cordR.law: a = 2nd derivative of the anchor position (px/s^2, canvas); F = -inertia_gain*4.0*a + wn^2*idle(t); v += dt*(F - 2*damping*wn*v - wn^2*x); x += dt*v (240Hz). output = 6*tanh(x/6) px

pony_delay.note: S_pony(t - tau): keep a ring buffer of the spring output (>=0.5 s) or use the 7 baked delayed samples (linear interpolation by tau)

parts.name: fill_behind_ponytail
parts.note_ja: ponytail の裏の塗り足し（ポニーテールが揺れた時だけ見える）

parts.name: blade_back
parts.note_ja: 刀身（顎の後ろ側の部分）。頭より奥に描く

parts.name: head
parts.note_ja: 頭（顔・髪・ヘアバンド）。顔は剛体のみ

parts.name: body
parts.note_ja: 体・腕・刀（柄・鍔・手）・フード。紐の下は塗り足し済み

fx.name: fx_blade_glint_mask
fx.use: SpriteMask（刀身の表側だけ光らせる範囲）

fx.name: fx_glint_band
fx.use: 加算マテリアル。刀身に沿って移動し、上のマスク内だけ表示。帯の中心を刀身方向に動かす。幅のガウス σ=13px(キャンバス)。canvas空間で回転 = 刀身の角度

fx.name: fx_sparkle
fx.use: 加算。帯の中心点に置く小さなきらめき（画面px基準のサイズ。E5b 0.62倍表示で 81px のまま）

glint.sweep: u = (ts)/(1.20) in 0..1 ; band centre along the blade = -10 + u*(L+20) px from blade_from ; strength k = sin(pi*u) ; sparkle at the same point (clamped to the blade)
glint.screen_add: rgb += band*mask*(255,244,228)*0.8*k ; sparkle = star*k (max with band)

face_variants.note: この子の被ダメ表情はまだ無い。SetFace(Hurt) は何もしない（警告ログのみ）。後で head_hurt.png を同じ矩形で用意すれば差し替えるだけで動く

panel.look: 素の色（グレード・リムなし）。UI（スキル列など）は上に重なる
